name: Translation Review
description: Reviews one locale of translated marketing copy against its English master for what rules can't check: changed or added claims, meaning drift, tone, literal idioms and untranslated words. Gives a second opinion on rule findings flagged for it. Returns findings only, never a verdict.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale under review, e.g. de-DE, copied exactly from the loop item. Echoed back unchanged.

parameters.name: review_input
parameters.description: This locale's review text, copied exactly from the loop item: one block per line (id, channel/field, Master, Translation, Length), then the 'Rule findings to double-check:' section, which says 'none.' when it is empty.

parameters.name: back_translation
parameters.description: The English back-translation of this locale's lines, labelled [L1], [L2] and so on, exactly as Back-translate to English returned it.

parameters.name: checksum
parameters.description: Integrity token for this locale, copied exactly from the loop item. Echoed back unchanged; never used in the review.

output.description: Findings for one locale (claim, meaning, tone, idiom, untranslated) and a second opinion on each listed rule finding, with locale and checksum echoed. Never a verdict.
